anomalies.title: Latency spikes
anomalies.detail: p99 exceeded 55 ms (three times the median second, or 20 ms) in 55 of 597 seconds; worst second 1527.5 ms.

anomalies.title: Throughput dips
anomalies.detail: Throughput fell below half the median second (608 req/s) in 39 of 597 seconds.

anomalies.title: Hook timeouts
anomalies.detail: The module ran past its 20 ms budget 83 times (0.02% of 332821 calls). Timed-out bids pass through unvalidated, so reject mode is best effort under timeout.

anomalies.title: Expected startup and shutdown errors
anomalies.detail: Currency and vendor-list fetches fail offline and are configured to give up after 1 ms; the shutdown notices come from stopping the server. Neither is a problem.
